description: Use this when the user has answered all 50 items of the IPIP Big-Five Factor Markers test (answers 1-5 in item order) and wants their personality test scores. Returns raw scores (10-50) for Extraversion, Agreeableness, Conscientiousness, Emotional Stability and Intellect/Imagination, an approximate percentile, a low/average/high band with a plain-language description, a share card (SVG) and a share page link. Reverse-keyed items are scored automatically. Does not diagnose anything and is not for hiring decisions. Do not use for other questionnaires (MBTI, DISC, Enneagram) or with invented answers.

answers.description: Required. The 50 answers in item order, each 1-5 (1 very inaccurate ... 5 very accurate), e.g. [4,2,4,2,4,2,5,2,4,2, ...]. A string like "4,2,4,2,...", "4242..." or a numbered list "1: 4, 2: 2, ..." also works. Use null for an unanswered item.

name.description: Optional first name or nickname for the share card, e.g. Alex. Leave empty for an anonymous card.

name: calculate_personality_scores
title: Calculate Big Five scores
